adaptation: Prospective public workload adaptation, not exact historical replay or a thinking-only ablation.
boundary: after and from are inclusive zero-based source indices. Desk rules arrive before the first goal. Day markers arrive before the seed at their from index. Each seed arrives once at the first goal with after >= its index. Each lookup version becomes eligible at from <= after; the latest eligible snapshot replaces the current id only when name or content changes.
